posts.text: A potential key growth trigger for Fermenta is the end of the current Vitamin D3 feed-price downcycle . Feed D3 prices have fallen sharply due to increased Chinese supply, but historically the market has moved through long supply-driven cycles. As Chinese supply rationalises or a supply disruption emerges, D3 prices could stabilise and recover , providing significant operating leverage to Fermenta. The company has already demonstrated pricing discipline by reducing volumes rather than selling aggressively at weak prices.
